Name: Stardew Re-Sprites - Valley Girls
Author: BroodingEvil
Description:
Attempting to keep with who the characters are, I've made Marnie a bit of a bbw, Olivia a milf etc..

I may or may not add lewd clothing based on their normal clothes as well, but that will likely come after I've completed the characters I want to re-sprite.
